classification_order: unit not invoked after a global stop -> UNIT_NOT_STARTED_AFTER_GLOBAL_STOP
explicit refusal or no response bytes -> SUCCESSOR_REFUSAL_OR_NO_OUTPUT
invalid UTF-8, malformed JSON, or response-schema failure -> RESPONSE_SCHEMA_FAILURE
compare route-trace fields in field_comparison_order and emit the first mismatch
all schema, status, and trace checks pass -> LIVE_INTERFACE_PASS

expected_matrix.note: No historical case prose; one neutral case_prose literal is frozen for all units.

not_scored: generalization, inheritance, Cognitive Evolution, Model-RSI, training benefit
pass_rule: Schema-valid response; expected status ROUTED for all 18 units; interface_error null; exact equality of every route-trace field to the deterministic R3 trace.
primary_endpoint: mechanical response/interface conformance to the exact deterministic R3 reference

thresholds.full_establishment: 18 of 18 attempted once and all 18 LIVE_INTERFACE_PASS, no protocol deviation, access events dispositioned before a positive claim
thresholds.invalidated: any protocol/source/hash deviation; stop immediately, do not continue and do not retry
thresholds.partial_establishment: 1 through 17 LIVE_INTERFACE_PASS among the fixed 18, no protocol deviation; counts only, no broader inference

transient_failure_policy: Timeouts, refusals, and process errors consume the sole attempt; never exclude or replace.
